standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the statement to successor and limit steps, each handled by a separate argument.

core_obligations: Recall that the extension is a well-ordered colimit whose successor steps are finite etale and whose limit steps are colimits of the earlier stages (proof lines 44869-44875).

Successor step: tensor a finite etale extension of a stage with the already constructed colimit presentation, which again presents the next stage as a colimit of finite etale extensions (proof lines 44878-44884).
Limit step: use that every finite subset of the stage lies in an earlier stage, so the property passes to the limit (proof lines 44884-44888).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to the successor case by tensoring the finite etale step (proof lines 44876-44884).
Pass to limits using finite subsets (proof lines 44884-44889).
difficulty_reason: For a local ring with residue field k and a separable algebraic extension K of k, the lemma produces a directed system of finite etale extensions of local rings whose colimit has residue field K (statement lines 44859-44866). The proof does not build the system directly: it takes the well-ordered extension constructed earlier, treats successor steps by tensoring a finite etale extension with the colimit presentation already obtained, and treats limit steps by observing that every finite subset lies in an earlier stage (proof lines 44868-44889). Splitting the transfinite induction into those two cases is the content, and the author writes both out. H2.
